description: This file contains unit tests for onboarding remote authentication prompts in the OpenClaw project, verifying error handling, UI behavior, and user messaging related to remote device authentication issues.

classes.name: OnboardingRemoteAuthPromptTests
classes.description: A test suite for onboarding remote authentication prompts, including error mappings and UI behavior.

methods.name: auth detail codes map to remote auth issues
methods.description: Tests mapping of GatewayConnectAuthError detail codes to RemoteGatewayAuthIssue enum values.

methods.name: password detail family maps to password required issue
methods.description: Tests mapping of password-related errors to PasswordRequired issue.

methods.name: token field visibility follows onboarding rules
methods.description: Verifies visibility rules for remote token field based on various onboarding states.

methods.name: pairing required copy points users to pair approve
methods.description: Ensures copying of pairing required issue provides correct instructions and labels.

methods.name: paired device success copy explains auth source
methods.description: Checks that success copy correctly describes the auth source used for connection.

methods.name: transient probe mode restore does not clear probe feedback
methods.description: Verifies that probe feedback isn't reset in certain modes, maintaining UI consistency.
